basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a high school student from California with a passion for online gaming, especially in Royal High and exploring fan communities. I enjoy trading and collecting rare items in games, and I love connecting with other players. I'm usually online in the evenings after school. I work part-time at a local cafe, which allows me to fund my in-game purchases. Single and enjoying the freedom to make new friends online!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of trading in games, mostly learned through trial and error and by watching tutorials on YouTube. I also dive into fandom discussions to stay updated on trends and new releases.
